group_manifest.proof_strategy: Adapt the accepted next-case structural proof pattern into current-group suffixed proved helpers; use current seed first-occurrence lemmas and original definition argument order. Reuse shared DLL decomposition/composition with arbitrary A/storeA and full unchanged payload frame. Handle member and sentinel returns with one segment-first observation. For generated return disjunctions the first disjunct suffices. For member variant prove sentinel exclusion before proving the postcondition wand. Do not import another case library or edit any common or generated file.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: s <> 0 -> xizi_dllseg n p s l xs |-- pure(n <> 0)

premises.discharged_by: s is the sentinel head, nonzero from the DLL predicate; empty segment gives n=s, nonempty gives n<>0.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: ~In node before -> s<>0 -> dllseg n p s l (before++node::after) |-- EX prev next, node<>0 /\ node<>s /\ next<>0 AND dllseg n p node prev before ** links node next prev ** dllseg next node s l after

premises.discharged_by: First occurrence decomposition gives ~In node before; the opened DLL gives s<>0. Induct on before and apply seg_nonzero to the suffix.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: node<>0 -> node<>s -> links s hf hl ** dllseg n p node prev before ** links node next prev ** dllseg next node s last after |-- links s hf hl ** dllseg n p s last (before++node::after)

premises.discharged_by: Member branch provides node<>0 and node<>head. Keep sentinel links in the inductive frame: any prefix address equal to s contradicts disjoint ownership via existing xizi_dll_links_neq__dll_len_payload_cycle.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: dllseg n p s l xs |-- pure((n=s -> first_value xs=0) /\ (n<>s -> first_value xs=n))

premises.discharged_by: No additional premises. Case split xs; empty DLL segment gives n=s; cons gives n=head(xs) and n<>s.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: In node xs -> dllseg n p s l xs |-- pure(node<>s)

premises.discharged_by: Membership is the member-case premise; induction on xs and the nonempty segment exclusion prove it.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: ~In node before -> dll head (before++node::after) |-- EX first last prev next, head<>0 /\ first<>0 /\ node<>0 /\ node<>head /\ next<>0 AND links head first last ** dllseg first head node prev before ** links node next prev ** dllseg next node head last after

premises.discharged_by: Unfold DLL, use seg_nonzero and seg_split; first-occurrence list lemma supplies freshness.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: head<>0 -> node<>0 -> node<>head -> links head first last ** dllseg first head node prev before ** links node next prev ** dllseg next node head last after |-- dll head (before++node::after)

premises.discharged_by: All three pure premises occur in member return VCs. Use seg_join with the retained sentinel links, then existing xizi_dll_close.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall A storeA head nodes node, In node (xizi_dll_ptrs nodes) -> xizi_store_dll storeA head nodes |-- pure(node<>head)

premises.discharged_by: Use shared dll_decompose, open structural DLL, apply seg_member_exclude; preserve payload frame.
